name: syle-web
description: syle.studio public photography portfolio + blog (Astro SSG).

scripts.images:generate: cargo run --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml --release -p syle-core --example optimize-static -- media-src/img public/project-media src/generated/static-images.json
scripts.build: pnpm images:generate && pnpm images:check && astro build && pnpm seo:check && pnpm budget
scripts.build:cached: pnpm images:check && astro build && pnpm seo:check && pnpm budget
